slides.title: Atlas chilled-coffee brand tracker: Wave 4 readout (2026-Q2, n=1,200, weighted)
slides.notes: Context slide; G1 only. Base (n=1,200), wave (W4/2026-Q2) and weighting stated correctly.

slides.title: Atlas health is up and top-of-funnel; Beacon now leads Meridian on consideration
slides.notes: Exec-summary SCR verdict; qualitative direction, competitor comparator named.

slides.title: Atlas aided awareness rose 6pts to 73%, its first significant gain in four waves
Consideration climbed 5pts to 38% of the market, tracking the awareness gain
slides.notes: consider T2B(total) +4.5pts to 37.7% (p=0.029); comparator vs W3 in subtitle.

slides.title: The gain is at the top: unaided awareness jumped 6pts to 37%
slides.notes: unaided +5.7pts to 36.5% (p=0.005); diagnostic 'at the top' conclusion.

slides.title: Awareness-to-consideration conversion held flat near 53%, so the lift is reach not persuasion
Usage is broadly stable at 15%, so the new interest has yet to reach trial
slides.notes: usage +2.4pts (p=0.10) not significant; 'broadly stable' defensibility guard.

slides.title: Beacon overtook Meridian on consideration for the first time in four waves, at 42%
Beacon and Meridian lead preference near 25%, with Atlas third at 20%
slides.notes: Preference standings (Meridian 24.9 / Beacon 24.8 / Atlas 19.5); no unsupported change claim.

slides.title: 'Innovative' associations rose 7pts to 37%, likely fuelling Atlas's awareness gain
'Worth the price' is broadly stable at 35%, within margin of error versus Q1
slides.notes: 'worth the price' -1.9pts (p=0.46) not significant; the defensibility-guard slide.

slides.title: Ad recall jumped 7pts to 26%, consistent with the awareness and innovation gains
slides.notes: ad recall +7.4pts to 26.4% (p<0.001); supporting driver evidence.

slides.title: Atlas's awareness gain is concentrated in the Growth segment, up 13pts to 46%
slides.notes: Growth unaided +13.4pts to 46.2% (p<0.001); the only significant segment divergence.

slides.title: Under-35s drove the gain, up 9pts to 42%; older buyers held steady
slides.notes: 18-34 unaided +8.9pts to 42.0% (p=0.006); older bands not significant (honest contrast).

slides.title: Convert Growth's new awareness: shift Q3 activation and trial offers to under-35s
slides.notes: Imperative and specific; ties to funnel (flat conversion) + segment (Growth/under-35) findings.

slides.title: Appendix: Atlas consideration distribution and top-two-box base, Wave 4
slides.notes: Appendix; G1 only. Distribution + T2B base reproducible from the exhibit.

slides.title: Appendix: Atlas NPS rose to +7 on a low base (n=189 users) — read directionally
slides.notes: Caveat stated as a conclusion (low base, read directionally); NPS +9.7pts not significant (p=0.25).
